title: Ride quality and smoothness
summary: Sampled feedback centers on the G70's ride quality, with explicit praise for smoothness, comfort, and the way the vehicle rides, while many other snippets mention the same theme without clear sentiment labeling.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the G70 for riding smoothly, comfortably, and impressively, with several customers explicitly saying they love or enjoy the way it rides.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined snippets also discuss ride quality and comfort, but the sampled wording is too brief or generic to reliably separate explicit praise from mere mention in every case.

limitations: Half of the topic's coded reviews are undetermined, so the available examples do not fully resolve sentiment for all ride-quality mentions.
The sampled fragments are short and repetitive, which limits detail about specific ride conditions or comparisons.
Samples are stratified and not representative, so these examples should not be treated as prevalence estimates for the full G70 review population.
